decided: Jeremy, 2026-11-13: chaser, loom and moving-dot z_eff is computed per arena at START from the rig's measured dish media stack; new identity versions semantic v5 + trial_index v4; no v4-to-v5 relabel
producer: Citrus PR #114 MERGED as be2cd47 (JohnsonLabJanelia/citrus main be2cd4759843567251427aed15f5e5e4b9a73df4, merge tree identical to head 168027d): v5 recipe 32bfe59, fixture commit b2630f5, z_eff H5 contract 97eb09c, omnifin0 tank-design values 168027d; the fixture and the trial index v4 schema are byte-identical on main
supersedes: semantic_policy_pairing_v3.json (revision 3). Revisions 2 and 3 are unchanged and stay pinned by whatever already pins them.
hash_rule: protocol_semantic_hash = 'sha256:' + hex(sha256(canonical_json_bytes)) over the exact recorded bytes; a consumer never re-canonicalises or regenerates them
mixing: the trial index version is fixed by the semantic policy: v2, v3 and v4 pair only with trial_index v3, and v5 only with trial_index v4. Any other combination is corruption and is refused. semantic v3, v4 or v5 under the legacy convention is refused, and so is an unknown policy (for example citrus.protocol.semantic.v6).

semantic_v5.changes_from_v4: normalization_policy is citrus.protocol.semantic.v5. On every chaser step (stimulus_mode_id 12) the hashed parameters object loses z_eff and gains z_eff_source. Everything else in the envelope and identity is hashed exactly as in v4, including identity.stimulus_render_rate_hz (an integer, always present, 120 or 240). Loom and moving-dot steps hash the same bytes as in v4, because they never hashed z_eff. Only the envelope policy changes, so every protocol's hash changes, including protocols without a chaser.

removed.rule: absent on every chaser step; not null, not present. A v5 identity carrying it is refused.

newly_hashed.rule: required on every chaser step; exactly the string "arena_media_stack"; a sibling of target_radius, ordered by the unchanged canonicaliser

semantic_v5.kept_from_v3: target_radius, chase-phase target_reference and loom under an appearance_drive stay required on chaser steps exactly as in v3/v4
semantic_v5.z_eff_rule: Citrus computes z_eff per arena at START from the rig file's measured media stack and uses that one value for chaser, loom and moving-dot visual angles. A protocol step that authors z_eff_mm > 0 is refused at load. The per-arena value is a recording fact, not a protocol fact: it is never in the semantic identity or the trial index, and it is recorded in the H5 (h5_z_eff below).
semantic_v5.why: the rendered dot size of a chaser, loom or moving-dot stimulus depends on z_eff. Under v3/v4 a chaser step carried an authored z_eff (14.942 in several protocols, defaulting to 10.4), which was wrong for the rig. v5 renders a different stimulus from the same protocol file, so one hash must never name both.

trial_index.changes_from_v3: schema_version 3 -> 4 and normalization_policy .v3 -> .v4. On chaser steps features.target.z_eff_mm is removed and features.target.z_eff_source = "arena_media_stack" is added. There are no other new keys. The bytes also differ in the embedded protocol_semantic_hash, and the execution-index hash changes because it embeds the trial-index hash.
trial_index.schema: Citrus src/schemas/protocol_trial_index_v4.schema.json at Citrus PR #114 head 32bfe59, sha256 1923a8de87ea59db672294f11d2c242c170973aff5c27c7e069644caff73bae1 (a copy of v3 with $id, title, description and the two version consts changed; neither constrains target.z_eff_*)

semantic_v5.seeds: per_session_v1 chaser seeds are sha256('citrus.chaser_schedule.seed.v1' | session_uuid | semantic_hash | step_index | occurrence), so they change with the semantic hash. session_uuid is included, so no two sessions ever shared a seed. fixed_v1 seeds are unchanged.

relabel_pooling_rule.rule_v4_to_v5: none. A v4 (or earlier) recording never joins a v5 protocol_semantic_hash group, by any byte rule or crosswalk.
relabel_pooling_rule.why: the chaser, loom and moving-dot stimuli were rendered at a different z_eff, so the shown stimulus differs even when the protocol file is otherwise identical
relabel_pooling_rule.earlier_rules: the revision-2 (v2 to v3) and revision-3 (v3 to v4) rules are unchanged and end at v4
relabel_pooling_rule.byte_observation: for a protocol with no chaser step the v5 bytes are the v4 bytes with only the normalization_policy label changed, so a label swap reproduces the v5 hash (fixture: phototaxis_gray035_1h_then_60x10s_seed1, solid_gray016_1h, synthetic_empty, at 120 and 240). It never does for a chaser protocol. A byte rule cannot tell a protocol whose loom or moving-dot steps render at the arena z_eff apart from one with no z_eff-dependent step, so this observation is not a pooling rule; rule_v4_to_v5 stays none.
relabel_pooling_rule.non_chaser_pooling: not now (Jeremy, 2026-11-14, relayed via data-export): rule_v4_to_v5 stays none for every protocol, including those without a chaser. Any future pooling rule must be mode-based, because loom and moving-dot steps render differently under the arena z_eff, and must be decided separately.

h5_z_eff.status: attribute contract final at Citrus PR #114 commit 97eb09c (names and fixed strings checked against src/calibration/media_stack_z_eff.cpp there); unchanged at 168027d, which only sets the tank-design values. It superseded the 21-attr draft when the 2026-11-14 geometry review split the dish-floor height into holder top (rig.yml rev 15) minus seat-to-floor depth. TODO: confirm against the v5 validation H5 (Citrus 97eb09c or later)

paths.citrus_source_namespace: /calibration_snapshot/z_eff (resolves to the unified path through the existing namespace binding /calibration_snapshot -> /geometry/calibration)

h5_z_eff.shape: a group with attributes only: no datasets, no child groups. One per arena H5. A sibling of the existing calibration children (camera groups, tank, arena_geometry).
h5_z_eff.required_when: every v5 recording; absent from v2-v4 recordings

attributes.formula_id: utf8; fixed value "citrus.z_eff.hung_dish_paraxial.v1" (kept through the 2026-11-14 geometry correction, Jeremy: no recording used it, the formula is unchanged, the new inputs are recorded with their sources)
attributes.z_eff_mm: float64; positive; (double)(float)((floor - base) + eye + (n_w/n_a)*base); equals float64(float32 arena_config_json.calculated_z_eff_mm), bit for bit
attributes.holder_top_above_image_plane_mm_source: utf8; fixed value "rig_file:media_stack.support.holder_top_above_film_mm" (pancakebatter rig.yml rev 15 key)
attributes.dish_floor_above_image_plane_mm: float64; DERIVED: holder_top_above_image_plane_mm - seat_to_floor_top_mm, bit for bit (one IEEE float64 subtraction of the two recorded doubles)
attributes.rig_file_sha256: utf8; 'sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex over the whole file bytes; equals /metadata/rig/pancakebatter_rig_file rig_file_sha256
attributes.rig_geometry_revision: int32 (H5T_NATIVE_INT), OPTIONAL: present only when the rig file has one (absent, never null); when present equals the rig pin group's revision
attributes.tank_design_file_sha256: utf8; 'sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex over the whole file bytes
attributes.arena_id: utf8; equals the recording's arena_config config_name

h5_z_eff.attribute_types: every attribute is scalar; numbers are H5T_NATIVE_DOUBLE (float64) except rig_geometry_revision (H5T_NATIVE_INT, int32); strings are variable-length C_S1 with cset UTF-8
h5_z_eff.closed: yes: exactly these 25 attributes (rig_geometry_revision optional, so 24 or 25 present); no datasets, no child groups
h5_z_eff.z_eff_source_in_h5: no. z_eff_source exists only in the protocol identity and the trial index, never in the H5
equalities: one float32 z is set per arena at START; z_eff_mm == float64(z), so each of the following, read from arena_config_json as float64, is bit-identical to z_eff_mm: calculated_z_eff_mm, dish_config.optics.z_eff_current_mm (the value the renderer uses), dish_config.optics.z_eff_larvae_mm, and the chaser rows' z_eff_mm

dish_config.optics.z_eff_adult_mm and dish_config.biological.adult_eye_height_mm are deleted from arena_config_json in v5-build files (Citrus PR #114 head 32bfe59); older H5s and canvas files still carry them. They are never part of any equality, and a consumer ignores them; their presence is not a refusal condition.
arena_id == the recording's arena config_name (/metadata/session arena_id)

rig_id and rig_file_sha256 == /metadata/rig/pancakebatter_rig_file rig_id and rig_file_sha256; rig_geometry_revision, when present, == that pin's revision. A mismatch means the rig file changed between START and logger open, a real fault; the recording is refused
h5_z_eff.admission: expected to ride unified H5 admission revision 7 with no catalog change (the group is uncataloged like tank and arena_geometry); Palette gates its checks on semantic policy v5. To be confirmed with the v5 validation H5.
h5_z_eff.attribute_naming: a source attr is the measured value's full name, unit included, + "_source": holder_top_above_image_plane_mm_source, seat_to_floor_top_mm_source, dish_floor_above_image_plane_mm_source, eye_height_above_floor_mm_source, refractive_index_acrylic_source, refractive_index_water_source (Jeremy 2026-11-13; Citrus PR #114 head 32bfe59)
h5_z_eff.start_refusals: Citrus START refuses with rig_media_stack_holder_top_missing until the rig file carries media_stack.support.holder_top_above_film_mm (rev 15), and with tank_design_seat_to_floor_top_missing until the tank design carries dimensions.seat_to_floor_top_mm; the deprecated dish_floor_above_film_mm is never read
h5_z_eff.omnifin0_values: informational, not pinned (Jeremy, 2026-11-14; Citrus 168027d): holder top 8.13 mm, seat_to_floor_top_mm 0 on both dishes (floor flush with the winglet seat), so dish_floor_above_image_plane_mm 8.13 in every arena; palm1 base 6.0 mm, palm2 base 3.0 mm; eye 1.4 mm assumed; z_eff_mm about 8.898 (palm1) and 9.214 (palm2). Exact float values come from the recording.
